repairs.quote: Seraphine unleashes a heavy soundwave, dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies in a line and Slowing them by 99% for 1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 seconds. Enemies that are already Slowed are Rooted instead, and Immobilized enemies are Stunned. Deals 70% damage against minions.
